title: Ochre Composition
provenance: Acquired by the Tan Hock Seng Collection, 1985; Sold to Mei-Ling Wong Gallery, 2010. Proven ownership by Mei-Ling Wong's estate from 2020 onward. The piece has been on loan to the Southeast Asian Heritage Society since 2015, under the care of its curator, Dr. Amira Kaur, until its auction in 2022.
